guides.title: FAQ
guides.content:
## Browse by category

- [Basics](#basics)
- [Story progression and key items](#story-progression-and-key-items)
- [Pokémon availability and encounters](#pokemon-availability-and-encounters)
- [Gameplay mechanics](#gameplay-mechanics)
- [Training and customization](#training-and-customization)
- [Items, money, and Pickup](#items-money-and-pickup)
- [Postgame and optional battles](#postgame-and-optional-battles)

## Basics

### Saves compatible between versions?
- Always

### Hard mode differences?
- Gym battles are double battles unless enforced into singles by another setting
- Trainers with no pre-assigned moves for their Pokémon generate slightly smarter movepools based on progression.

### Kanto?
- No kanto, pure Johto focus.

### When is Morning/Day/Evening/Night?
- Morning is 06:00-10:00, Day 10:00-19:00, Evening 19:00-20:00 and Night 20:00-06:00.

### When does night time start?
- 20:00 ingame time.

### Dexnav?
- After obtaining first set of Poké Balls.

### Unregistering dexnav species?
- Select in the dexnav screen.

### Where is X Item/Pokémon/TM?
- Check docs or ingame pokedex.

## Story progression and key items

### Exp. Share?
- Given right before arriving in the Violet City.

### HMs?
- Requires only owning the HM and the corresponding badge. Additionally you can Fly using the Region Map in Pokégear after obtaining the HM.

### Strength HM?
- Olivine Cafe.

### Waterfall hM?
- Ice path.

### How do I access Whitney's Gym?
- Go to the Radio Tower and complete the quiz on the first floor

### How do I remove the weird tree after beating 3rd Gym?
- Go to Goldenrod Flower Shop next to the gym and get Squirtbottle to wake up the tree.

### What's Candy Jar and how do I get it?
- After beating the first gym, Elm's aide will give it to you alongside the egg. It will accumulate extra exp from battles and convert them to Exp Candy on use.

### Mega Ring?
- After Team Rocket takeover event in Goldenrod City.

### How to get starter megastone/bondstone?
- Given to you by Elm at a certain point in story.

### Coin case?
- Goldenrod Underground

### Cameron locations?
- Ruins of Alph, Route 34, Cianwood City, Kitakami Border and Route 28.

## Pokémon availability and encounters

### How do I get the other starters?
- The Gachapon machine in Goldenrod Casino, behind the rewards counter, can give starters from any generation. 3000 Coins is the minimum entry, but putting more increases the chance of not receiving a duplicate starter.

### Regional Pokémon?
- Most are available in the Baoba's Safari Zone, but several can be found before this.

### Shiny odds?
- 1/256. Eggs will show with blue dots if they are shiny.

### Shiny locks?
- None. Even NPC trades can be shiny.

### How often do Hidden Grotto contents respawn?
- Once per day, but you can also use Beckoning Bell item from Battle Factory after Gym 3.

### Are Pokémon found from Hidden Grottos any different from regular wild ones?
- Pokémon from Hidden Grottos have atleast two perfect IVs and their Hidden Ability. They have 60% chance of containing a Pokémon, 30% of having a generic item and 10% of having a grotto specific item

### Fossils?
- Smash rocks in Ruins of Alph.

### Baby forms?
- Breed with incenses, see https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Baby_Pok%C3%A9mon#List_of_baby_Pok%C3%A9mon for more information.

### What are the ingame trades?
- Pawmi in Violet (for Cottonee)
- G-Slowpoke in Azalea (for regular Slowpoke)
- Honedge in Goldenrod Dept Store (for Clefairy),
- Hisui-Voltorb in Olivine (for Mareanie)
- Gabite in Blackthorn City (for Dragonair)
- Meltan in Rinto Village (for Tinkaton)

## Gameplay mechanics

### Type changes?
- None during the main game. Only some might gain one extra type during postgame from an innate.

### BST Changes?
- None.

### Moves changes?
- Yes, some Pokémon learn extra moves for a bit more late game power. Such as Attack Order Beedrill.

### How to mega evolve?
- Press start when selecting moves while the Pokémon is wielding appropriate Mega stone and you have the Mega Ring

### Should I hold off evolving Growlithe/Vulpix/etc?
- No, the evolved forms learn all the moves the pre-evoluion form does.

### How do I change Rotom form?
- After obtaining a Rotom, bring it to the guard on the first floor of Goldenrod Apartment building. You can then access the basement with form changing appliances.

## Training and customization

### Grinding Exp for late game?
- Kitakami has an Audino/Blissey trainer for a fee of 10,000 pokedollars.

### Nature mints?
- Olivine beach cafe sells them.

### Ability changing?
- Battle Factory (after 3rd gym) offers them for playing a few rounds. Few can also be found in the overworld.

### Tutor moves?
- There's a tutor move master in Olivine City in the top-right house who will sell you infinite access to all Tutor moves for 44444 pokedollars. After buying it, you can teach tutor moves from the summary screen.

### Egg moves?
- Blackthorn City egg move master sells you infinite access to egg moves for 88888 pokedollars similar to tutor move master.

### Why do innates unlock so late?
- They are meant to act as a form of postgame progression. Most Pokémon stop learning moves around 60~ usually, so this gives something to look forward to after that. If you really want to play with innates during the main game, you can activate them from the bookcase behind the starter case table in Elm's lab. However this will be a very unbalanced experience and not the intended way to play.

### Raising IVs?
- Fishing and Battle Factory (after gym 3) can net you feather items which permanently raise your IVs by 4 with each use. Additionally Hyper Training is available in Rinto Village with Bottle Caps (which can also be obtained by fishing with Super Rod).

### Raising EVs?
- EV items such as Power Weight have been greatly buffed, and they are buyable in Goldenrod. Additionally vitamins like Protein are not capped at 100 EVs anymore, and there are EX versions of the items that raise the stats instantly to max.

### Lowering EVs?
- Goldenrod Dept. Store sells EV reducing berries?

## Items, money, and Pickup

### Tips for finding items that are held by wild Pokémon?
- Have a Pokémon with ability Compoundeyes or Super Luck in the first party slot to increase the chances of wild Pokémon holding an item.

### Tips for getting money?
- Early game, have a Pokémon with ability Pickup. In this hack if the held item slot is occuped, items picked by Pickup will still go to bag. Later on you can fish feathers or smash rocks for shards and sell them for quick cash. After reaching Goldenrod, you can start coveting/thieving Yanmas on Route 35 for Wide Lenses, they sell for a lot of money and can be easily farmed with Dexnav chain. Butterfree learns Covet and Persian learns Thief. After obtaining 8 badges, Battle Factory will stock Nuggets and Big Nuggets. In the post game you can farm money from the Rocket Arcade facility.

- Below is the table of items found with Pickup. Note that the items go straight to bag if held item slot is occupied.

guides.title: How to report a bug
guides.summary: Found a bug? Report it to the dev!
guides.content:
### How to report a bug you found
- Before reporting a bug, make sure you are actually on the latest version of the rom. You can find the latest version from https://www.hackdex.app/hack/soulgold.
- Additionally make sure that you are using one of the emulators listed under "Supported emulators" on the hackdex page. I won't take bug reports from potentially inaccurate emulators.
- If the two above criteria are checked, you can report the bug in the discord for the hack OR open an issue report https://github.com/Eemeliri/soulgold/issues

guides.title: Legendary locations
guides.summary: Where to find currently obtainable legendaries
guides.content:
## Legendary Pokémon

#### Articuno

Found in Snowtop Mountain. Rock Climb is required.

#### Zapdos

Found at the top of Olivine Lighthouse after obtaining the eighth badge.

#### Moltres

Found in Victory Road.

#### Galarian Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres

Each bird can be purchased from the Route 50 Battle Café for 5 points.

#### Mewtwo

Found in Nameless Dungeon at Kitakami Border after defeating the Elite Four. Rock Climb is required.

#### Mew

After obtaining eight badges, visit Olivine City's port and find Blaine. Defeat him to unlock Faraway Island, where Mew can be found.

#### Raikou, Entei, and Suicune

All three begin roaming after the Burned Tower event.

#### Lugia

Choose the Silver Wing after the Rocket takeover. If you chose the Rainbow Wing instead, speak with the Director after defeating the Elite Four and prepare for a fight.

#### Shadow Lugia

Explore south of Johto to find the Abandoned Rocket Warehouse. Solve its puzzles to obtain a Dark Crystal, then bring it to the regular Lugia encounter.

If you have already caught Lugia, complete one round of Title Defense to reset the spawn. If you chose Ho-Oh during the main story, defeat the Director in the postgame to obtain the Silver Wing.

#### Ho-Oh

Choose the Rainbow Wing after the Rocket takeover. If you chose the Silver Wing instead, speak with the Director after defeating the Elite Four and prepare for a fight.

#### Celebi

Solve all eight Ruins of Alph puzzles: four slider puzzles and four wall puzzles. Enter a passage in B1F to find the GS Ball, take it to Kurt in Azalea Town, then visit the Ilex Forest shrine.

[spoiler=Ruins of Alph wall puzzle solutions]
- ESCAPE: Use an Escape Rope from the Bag.
- WATER: Use a Water Stone from the Bag.
- LIGHT: Use Flash from the party menu.
- HOOH: Bring Ho-Oh with you.
[/spoiler]

#### Regirock

Solve the braille puzzle in Vajra Desert West.

[spoiler=Regirock puzzle solution]
Bring Tyranitar to the wall.
[/spoiler]

#### Regice

Solve the braille puzzle in Snowtop Mountain.

[spoiler=Regice puzzle solution]
Bring Baxcalibur to the wall.
[/spoiler]

#### Registeel

Solve the braille puzzle in Railway Cave.

[spoiler=Registeel puzzle solution]
Bring Kommo-o to the wall.
[/spoiler]

#### Latias and Latios

Both are found in the Vajra Desert East temple during the postgame.

#### Kyogre

After completing the Darkrai event, your rival gives you the Dive HM. Surf south from Route 33 and take the first left to find a dive spot containing Kyogre.

#### Groudon

After completing the Darkrai event, your rival gives you the Dive HM. A dive spot on Route 50 leads to a small cave containing Groudon.

#### Rayquaza

Defeat Steven in the Kitakami house after becoming Champion, then visit Embedded Tower.

#### Jirachi

Complete the rival story at Mt. Silver.

#### Uxie

Found at the Rock Climb spot on Route 30 near the Berry Man's house.

#### Mesprit

Found at the Rock Climb spot on Route 47 near the final bridge before Route 48.

#### Azelf

Found at the Rock Climb spot in Mahogany Town.

#### Dialga, Palkia, and Giratina

Obtain Hoopa and solve all eight Ruins of Alph puzzles. Return to the secret room that held Celebi with Hoopa in your party, then interact with the back wall to find portals leading to Dialga, Palkia, and Giratina.

#### Primal Dialga
Have Grovyle, Dusknoir and Celebi in your party and interact with the Time Gear on Spear Pillar Summit.

#### Heatran

Explore the depths of Mt. Mortar after obtaining Waterfall and Rock Climb.

[spoiler=Heatran puzzle solution]
Select the lower line and the middle top.
[/spoiler]

#### Regigigas

Bring Regirock, Regice, and Registeel to the Mt. Silver back room.

#### Cresselia

After completing the rival story at Mt. Silver, speak with your rival in their house to begin the quest. Go to the Lake of Rage, speak with the Hidden Power Dude, then explore the north-east corner of the lake.

#### Phione

Fish with a Good Rod or Super Rod in the South Johto Sea area where only Shellos and Gastrodon can be encountered.

#### Manaphy

Evolve Phione at level 58.

#### Darkrai

After obtaining Cresselia, show it to your rival in their house. Go to Cherrygrove City and enter the inn with Cresselia in your party.

[spoiler=Darkrai inn puzzle solution]
1. Accept the Moon Key.
2. Go to your room at the top of the stairs, examine the bed, and choose not to sleep or resist sleeping.
3. Go outside, return to the lobby, and inspect the papers on the wall.
4. Inspect the Luxray trophy in the long hallway.
5. Inspect the old telephone on the front desk and call the number formed by the stack of papers.
6. Examine the piano to find a small key, then use it on the nearby safe.
7. Walk upstairs to find Darkrai.
[/spoiler]

#### Shaymin

Found in the Dream Garden, accessible from Tohjo Falls after obtaining Rock Climb.

#### Victini

After becoming Champion, speak with the old woman in the Kitakami Border house and defeat every Gym Leader rematch.

#### Cobalion

Found through the Route 33-side exit of Railway Cave after becoming Champion.

#### Terrakion

Found in Dark Cave North after becoming Champion.

#### Virizion

Found on Route 50.

#### Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus

Each force can be purchased from the Battle Café for 5 points. Your first force purchase also grants the Reveal Glass.

#### Meloetta

After becoming Champion, Meloetta can be found in the Ecruteak Dance Theater.

#### Genesect

Can be found in the Abandoned Rocket Warehouse after becoming Champion.

#### Eternal Floette

Obtain 60 trophies.

#### Diancie

Defeat every regular Battle Café opponent once, then claim Diancie from the café owner.

#### Hoopa

Complete the Rinto Village trade that gives Tinkaton to the scientist in the bottom house. After becoming Champion, explore the depths of Vajra Pyramid and prepare for several battles.

#### Magearna

After becoming Champion, enter the Rocket Arcade and speak with the burglar. Win 25 Arcade rounds and speak with him again to receive a key to the top floor of Goldenrod Apartment. Prepare for a fight.

#### Original Color Magearna

Obtain 100 trophies.

#### Marshadow

After obtaining the eighth badge, return to Elder Li in Sprout Tower and prepare for a battle. Afterwards, explore the Sprout Tower basement.

#### Tapus

Each tapu can be purchased from the Route 50 Battle Café for 5 points.

#### Poipole

Obtain 45 trophies.

#### Zeraora

Reach a 30-win streak in the Battle Tower to make Zeraora appear outside the tower.

#### Meltan

Trade for Tinkaton in Rinto Village.

#### Kubfu

Found in the Rock Climb cave in Blackthorn City. The evolution scrolls can be purchased from the Rocket Arcade for a very high price.

[spoiler=Kubfu cave solution]
Go down, up, left, up, left, down, right, right.
[/spoiler]

#### Zarude

Obtain 75 trophies.

#### Bloodmoon Ursaluna

Explore Kitakami Mountain to find the Black Mirror, then go to the Lost Woods.

[spoiler=Bloodmoon Ursaluna route solution]
Follow the Murkrow.
[/spoiler]

#### Paradox Pokémon

Explore South Johto's Meteor Island.

#### Chien-Pao

After obtaining Waterfall and Rock Climb, explore deeper into Ice Path.

#### Chi-Yu

Fish from the water fountain in Battle Cafe.

#### Walking Wake, Gouging Fire, and Raging Bolt

Register every past Paradox Pokémon in the Pokédex, then interact with the Unown wall at the back.

[spoiler=Past Paradox wall puzzle solution]
In the next room, bring Entei, Raikou, and Suicune to their respective walls to open them.
[/spoiler]

#### Iron Leaves, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown

Register every future Paradox Pokémon in the Pokédex, then interact with the wall at the back.

[spoiler=Future Paradox wall puzzle solution]
Bring Virizion, Terrakion, and Cobalion to their respective walls to unlock them.
[/spoiler]

#### Koraidon/Miraidon

Both can be purchased from the Route 50 Battle Café for 25 points after obtaining all other Paradox Pokémon.

#### Fezandipiti

After obtaining Rock Climb, explore Kitakami.

#### Ogerpon

Explore Kitakami Mountain.

guides.title: Hidden Grotto locations
Shiny hunting tips
guides.summary: A short guide for hunting shinies.
guides.content:
## Basics

- Every Pokémon you can obtain can be shiny, even traded Pokémon. There are no shiny locks.
- The shiny odds are 1/256.
- DexNav Pokémon have a higher chance of being shiny at streaks of 50 and 100.

## Elm's lab starters

1. Save in front of the starter case before opening it.
2. Open the case and check the starters. A shiny starter has a gold colored ball, and its sprite is shiny when hovered.
3. If the starter you want is not shiny, soft reset the game and check again.

## Eggs

- Eggs use the base 1/256 odds. The Masuda Method is not enabled in this hack.
- Gift eggs can be shiny just like any regular gift Pokémon.
- Shiny eggs have blue dots on their sprite.
- An egg's shininess when breeding at the Day Care is decided when the egg is spawned at the Daycare Man, not when it's accepted/hatches.
- The Day-Care Man says, "This Egg looks quite different from the ones we usually see!" when a shiny egg is ready. This message is shown before he asks if you want the egg.
- Accept the egg after the special message. Otherwise, decline it and walk until another egg is ready.

## Legendaries, statis encounters and gifts

Save directly before starting the encounter or receiving the Pokémon. If it is not shiny, soft reset and try again.
Gift Pokémon show as shiny in the preview screen when received.

Raikou, Entei and Suicune are rolled when they are released in Burned Tower. Their shininess does not change each time they are encountered. It is recommended that you instead Shiny Genome them if you wish to have them as shiny.

## NPC trades

NPC trades can be shiny and have 12 times the normal shiny chance. Save before completing the trade, then soft reset if needed. The sprite will show as shiny during the trade animation.


## Note about save states

You may use save states to shiny hunt many of these faster, but you have to occasionally advance the RNG by opening a bag or taking a few steps for example, so that you don't get stuck in the same outcomes.

guides.title: Trophy milestones
guides.summary: Milestone rewards for earning enough trophies
guides.content:
## Trophies
![](images/achievements.png){small}
There are over 100 trophies to obtain in Soulgold, and you are rewarded for reaching certain
milestones when obtaining enough of them.

Speak to the gentleman in Route 40 house to collect rewards and to check your current progress towards the next milestone.

![](images/achievementdude.png){small}

## The rewards

### 15 trophies

- **Reward** Shiny Patch
    - This consumable turns any Pokémon you own into a shiny version!

### 30 achievements

- **Reward:** Ash-Greninja
    - This Pokémon has a special ability **Battle Bond** which allows it to transform after KOing an opponent.
![](images/achievementsdude2.png){small}

### 45 achievements

- **Reward:** Poipole
    - Ultra Beast that starts off weak, but turns into a powerful Pokémon after learning Dragon Pulse.

### 60 achievements
- **Reward:** Eternal Floette
    - A special Floette capable of Mega Evolution and boasting much higher stats than your average Floette. 

### 75 achievements
- **Reward:** Zarude
    - A mythical Pokémon from the jungle. 

### 100 achievements
- **Reward:** Original Color Magerna
    - This version of Magerna is usually given for completing the Pokédex, however this time it can be obtained by completing 100 achievemnts. Quite a feat! 



> Note: All the Pokémon given by the gentleman can be shiny, and they will show as one in the preview picture if they are shiny.

guides.title: Gift and Trade Pokémon
guides.summary: List of all gift and trade Pokémon, and their locations
guides.content:
### Gift Pokémon


### Cherrygrove City: 
- A Choice between Alolan Rattata and Galarian Zigzagoon after player obtains the first Poké Balls.


### Ruins of Alph. 
- Handing fossils from smashing rocks in the Ruins of Alph to the scientist in the building will give player an appropriate Fossil Pokémon.


### Odd Egg from rival
- Bagon, Gible, Feebas, Riolu, Jangmo-o, H-Zorua or Goomy.


### Goldenrod: 
- Bill gives a choice between Let's Go Eevee and Pikachu after speaking to him in the Ecruteak Pokémon Center.


### Cianwood: 
- Gimmighoul from one of the houses.


### Mt Mortar: 
- Tyrogue after beating the Karate King.


### Blackthorn City: 
- Dratini after answering the Dragon Den Shrine's questions and speaking with Clair. This Dratini has an unique move "Spacial Rend".


### Kitakami: 
- Beldum from Steven.


### Goldenrod Casino: 
- All starters can be obtained from the Gachapon machine behind the rewards counter by paying a minimum of 3000 coins. Putting in more coins reduces the chance of getting a starter you already have.


### Route 40: 
- Achievements Man hands you certain Pokémon for reaching milestones in the amount of trophies you have. The exact Pokémon can be found in the Achievement milestones guide [here](https://eemeliri.github.io/soulgold/guides/achievement-rewards/)


### Trade Pokémon


### Pawmi 
- Violet City, requires Cottonee.


### Galarian Slowpoke
- Azalea Town, requires regular Slowpoke.


### Honedge 
- Goldenrod Dept Store, requires Clefairy.


### Rotom
- Route 39-Route 49 Gatehouse, requires Zorua.


### Hisui-Voltorb
- Olivine City, requires Mareanie.


### Meltan 
- Rinto Village, requires Tinkaton.


### Gabite
- Blackthorn City, requires Dragonair.
